The gate fails a category whose passed count is below GATE_DROP_THRESHOLD (default 70 percent) of its value here, unless it was started with --allow-count-drop "<reason>". Refresh from "baseline_candidate" of a GREEN gate report after each release. Only tier L has a baseline; S and M print a warning (the count-drop check is not applied).
